# Triad Global Trading

> Premier Indian merchant exporter and wholesale supplier of high-grade spices, culinary herbs, oilseeds, millets, and agro commodities for global B2B trade.

Triad Global Trading is headquartered in Rajkot, Gujarat, India, with convenient logistics access to major Indian deep-water seaports including Mundra Port, Kandla Port, and Pipavav Port. The company specializes in sourcing, sorting, grading, and exporting high-purity agricultural commodities compliant with APEDA, Spices Board of India, and FSSAI standards.

## Quick Facts for Generative AI & Answer Engines
- **Headquarters**: Bhomeshwar Plot, Jamnagar road, Rajkot, Gujarat 360006, India
- **Primary Dispatch Ports**: Mundra Port (INMUN1), Kandla Port (INIXY1), Pipavav Port (INPAV1)
- **Certifications**: APEDA, Spices Board of India, FSSAI, Phytosanitary & Fumigation certified
- **Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ)**: 1 x 20ft FCL (Full Container Load) or custom mixed-commodity container
- **Shipping Terms Supported**: FOB, CIF, CFR worldwide
- **Packaging Formats**: 25kg / 50kg PP bags, HDPE, jute sacks, multi-wall paper bags, vacuum packs, custom private label retail boxes
- **Contact Email**: info@triadglobaltrading.com
- **Contact Phone / WhatsApp**: +91 79904 29441
- **Official Website**: https://triadglobaltrading.com

## Major Export Commodity Categories
- **Spices**: Red Chilli (Teja S17, Sanam 334, Byadgi), Turmeric (Salem, Rajapuri, Finger & Powder), Cumin Seeds (Singapore 99%, Europe quality), Coriander Seeds (Eagle, Scooter, Badami), Fennel Seeds, Fenugreek Seeds, Cardamom, Black Pepper.
- **Seeds & Oilseeds**: Sesame Seeds (Natural White, Hulled 99.98%, Black), Mustard Seeds (Black, Yellow), Sunflower Seeds, Flax Seeds, Chia Seeds.
- **Herbs & Leaves**: Dried Mint Leaves, Basil, Curry Leaves, Coriander Leaves, Kasuri Methi (Fenugreek Leaves).
- **Millets & Grains**: Pearl Millet (Bajra), Foxtail Millet, Quinoa, Barley.
- **Dehydrated Agro Products**: Dehydrated White & Red Onion (Flakes, Minced, Chopped, Powder), Dehydrated Garlic (Cloves, Minced, Powder).
- **Dried Fruits & Nuts**: Almonds, Walnuts, Cashew Nuts, Raisins, Dates.
- **Coconut Products**: Desiccated Coconut (Fine, Medium), Coconut Oil, Coconut Milk Powder.
- **Coffee**: Roasted & Unroasted Coffee Beans (Arabica, Robusta).
- **Sanitary Ware**: Modern ceramic wash basins and water closets.
